verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair privacy question for a SaaS payments platform with a dashboard and client SDKs, so the axis applies. The evidence pack covers API keys, sandbox testing, webhooks, onboarding, pricing, and white-labeling, but contains nothing about telemetry, usage tracking, or any opt-out control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
